headline: Chile Fuel Price Stabilization Mechanism Could Exceed $1 Billion Fiscal Cost
summary: A report by OCEC-UDP warned that Chilean government measures to cap retail fuel price increases through April 2027 could carry a total fiscal burden surpassing $1 billion if crude prices cross $100.
why: Fuel subsidy and price stabilization policies protect domestic consumer inflation but expand government fiscal deficits and public debt requirements.

impacts.name: Chile
impacts.why: Potential fiscal spending overruns for energy caps put upward pressure on Chilean public debt balance sheets.
